title: 1996 Topps The X-Files #40 Paranormals Episode 3 Trading Card
descriptionText: The Topps 1996 The X-Files Trading Card #40 feature a standard sized design with English language text. This original, non-sport trading card is part of the base set and showcases characters and elements from the popular sci-fi TV show, The X-Files. Manufactured by Topps in the United States, this collectible card is a must-have for fans of the franchise looking to add to their trading card collection.
